articles.title: Tyreek Hill’s divorce explodes as estranged wife demands answers on alleged bribery payoff
articles.standfirst: Court filings allege Hill hasn't fully answered questions involving former partner Crystal Espinal
articles.summary: Court filings allege Hill hasn't fully answered questions involving former partner Crystal Espinal
articles.body:
The legal fight between Tyreek Hill and estranged wife Keeta Hill is moving well beyond the end of their marriage, with the latest dispute centering on whether the former Miami Dolphins star improperly tried to influence a witness tied to his past.

According to court documents cited by TMZ, Keeta is asking the court to compel Hill to provide fuller answers about whether he offered, promised or paid “any consideration” to Crystal Espinal , his former partner and the mother of three of his children.

Keeta claims Hill hadn't spoken with Espinal in more than five years before one of his attorneys contacted her roughly a week before her scheduled deposition in the divorce case. The lawyer allegedly told Espinal there “needs to be trust” and that they “needed to bridge the gap.”

The filing further alleges that Hill then traveled to Arkansas to see Espinal and their children for the first time in two years.

Keeta wants answers over Hill’s contact with Espinal

The questions carry added weight because Espinal has previously made serious allegations against Hill , all of which require careful distinction from proven facts.

She accused Hill of physically abusing her while she was pregnant, allegations he denied.

The two were also involved in a 2019 child abuse investigation after concerns were raised about injuries to their son. A secretly recorded conversation that later became public included Espinal saying their son was “terrified” of Hill .

“You need to be terrified of me too, b*tch,” Hill replied in the recording.

The Kansas City Chiefs , his team at the time, barred him indefinitely from club activities during the controversy. The NFL later declined to suspend him after its investigation.

Keeta is now asking the court to make Hill clarify whether any payment, promise or benefit was offered to Espinal ahead of her testimony.

Filing raises allegations involving other women

The court battle doesn't stop with Espinal . Keeta also alleges that a woman named Sasha Iolani contacted her in April 2025 with a disturbing message.

“Despite everything you just went through with your altercation. I know how he gets. I was a victim of it for four years … stay resilient, you’re more powerful than you think,” the message allegedly said.

The filing also raises questions about another woman, Mila Kukarets , with Keeta alleging that Hill initially denied knowing her before changing his account after learning that messages existed.

The divorce itself was filed in 2025, one day after police responded to a domestic disturbance at the couple’s Sunny Isles Beach condominium.

Keeta ’s mother called police because she feared for her daughter’s safety. Keeta told authorities that Hill threw a laptop to the floor and took their daughter during an argument.

According to the police report, Hill said: “I have the same rights as a father as her as a mother, and I can take my baby whenever I want.”

The latest filing shows that Keeta wants far more disclosure about Hill’s contacts and conduct as the divorce fight continues to escalate.
